sqlquery.from:
( SELECT s.id as surveyID, s.name, u.id as esduser_id, se.text, array_to_string(array_agg(case when cha.id is not null then (case when chlv.id is null then cha.value_text when chlv.is_editable=false then chlv.name else chlv.name || ' ' || cha.value_text end) when lv.id is null then sa.value_text when lv.is_editable=false then lv.name else lv.name || ' ' || sa.value_text end), ', ') as answer, u.firstname || ' ' || u.lastname as respondent, u.username as username, sr.start_date as start_date, sr.ip_adress as ip_address, sr.status as submission_status, s.status as survey_status, se.id as questionid, se.order as questionorder FROM (select survey_resp.* from "$".bmt_survey_response survey_resp WHERE survey_resp.status != 'DELETED') sr left join "$".bmt_survey_response chsr on sr.id=chsr.parent_id inner join (select survey.* from "$".bmt_survey survey where survey.status != 'DELETED') s on sr.survey_id = s.id inner join "$".bmt_survey_answer sa on sa.response_id=sr.id OR sa.response_id=chsr.id inner join "$".bmt_survey_elem se on sa.elem_id = se.id left join "$".bmt_list_value lv on sa.list_value_id = lv.id
left join "$".bmt_survey_answer cha on sa.id=cha.parent_id left join "$".bmt_list_value chlv on cha.list_value_id = chlv.id
left join "$".myUser u on u.id=sr.respondent_id group by s.id, s.name,u.id,se.text,u.firstname,u.lastname,u.username,sr.start_date,sr.ip_adress,sr.status,s.status,se.id,se.order order by s.id, se.order) t
